cohort: 257 pregnant women with morbid (BMI ≥40 kg/m2) or super‐obesity (BMI ≥50 kg/m2)
finding: The establishment of a dedicated antenatal clinic for women with morbid or super-obesity was well-received by patients and provided enhanced surveillance, continuity of care, and care coordination.
mod_finding: The clinic had a high rate of labor induction (49.8% requiring cervical ripening), elective caesarean section (37%), and emergency caesarean section (24.1%).
